build_status.notes: Frontend production build succeeded with Next.js 16.3.0; backend NestJS build succeeded.

test_status.details: Frontend Vitest: 18 files passed, 160 tests passed. Backend Jest: 538 passed, 3 failed due missing real Postgres in transfers integration tests (ECONNREFUSED).

inventory.database_configuration: Prisma PostgreSQL datasource present at prisma/schema.prisma; no active local Postgres instance was available for the real transfer integration tests.
inventory.prisma_configuration: generator client outputs to apps/backend/src/generated/prisma and schema includes user/account/category/transaction/audit models and indexes.
inventory.pwa_configuration: Next metadata manifest exists at src/app/manifest.ts and service worker exists at public/sw.js.
inventory.service_worker: public/sw.js caches shell/static assets and ignores API requests; registration occurs in app providers when running in production.
inventory.manifest: manifest.webmanifest generated by Next metadata, with icons and standalone display config.
inventory.caching_strategy: Shell and static asset caching; API traffic is ignored by service worker and handled by app logic.
inventory.api_client: Frontend uses app-level services and axios-like wrappers; backend exposes REST API under /api/v1.
inventory.auth_flow: JWT/login + refresh token flow present in backend and frontend auth state management.
inventory.refresh_token_flow: Refresh-token rotation and session handling are implemented in backend schema and auth logic; not fully exercised in the browser because backend API was not running with valid CORS configuration.
inventory.transaction_flow: Frontend transaction services and offline sync queue exist. Offline writes are queued locally and flushed when network returns.
inventory.dashboard_reporting: Route-level pages exist for dashboard, analytics, reports, notifications, budgets, and goals.
inventory.offline_handling: OfflineProvider and syncController exist; transaction mutations are queued when offline, but end-to-end network sync could not be validated without the backend running.
inventory.error_loading_retry: State management and offline sync include retry logic, failed sync states, and offline banners.

blockers: No real Postgres database instance was available for the transfers integration concurrency suite; Prisma connection attempts failed with ECONNREFUSED.
No real Android/iOS devices were available for physical validation; only browser-based emulation was possible.
No benchmark framework or real production-like load harness was configured for full latency/throughput measurement.
The browser runtime showed CORS-blocked API requests to localhost:3001, confirming the local API backend was not available in the browser environment during smoke testing.
The @nestjs/swagger -> js-yaml advisory remains unresolved upstream and is explicitly documented as an exception.
recommendations: Provision a local Postgres-backed backend and run the transfers integration concurrency suite end-to-end.
Add a real mobile/PWA validation harness with device emulation or real-device testing.
Add deterministic performance baselines for dashboard, reports, and transaction endpoints in a staging environment.
Keep the upstream @nestjs/swagger/js-yaml security exception documented until a patched stable release is available and independently validated.
Continue with Phase H or Phase I only after real environment validation is available.
